source.quote: Los Teros en el Estadio Charrúa por la Nations Cup. Foto: Leonardo Mainé.
source.note: Coverage of Uruguay v Georgia, Nations Cup round 1, Estadio Charrúa, 4 July 2026. The El País photo of a Uruguay ball-carrier (current 2025/26 home shirt) shows the Kingspan lion and wordmark across the front of the chest. Also shown on the Prensa URU photo with Americas Rugby News' report of the same match. elpais.com.uy blocks some scripted clients (403); the page and its photos were checked.

source.name: Americas Rugby News: 'Uruguay and Georgia Play Out Entertaining Match in Montevideo'
source.quote: Uruguay and Georgia played out an entertaining match at the Estadio Charrúa on Saturday.
source.note: The report's photo (credited 'Foto: Prensa URU') of Uruguay players shows the front of the current home shirt: the Kingspan lion and wordmark across the chest, with the 'antel' script logo below it. The same pairing appears in the Prensa URU photo on Americas Rugby News' report of Uruguay v Hong Kong (18 July 2026). Antel is listed on the URU website as a main sponsor.

source.note: The El País photo of the team huddle (behind the players) shows the back of the shirts: 'pax assistance' in white on the upper back, below the collar and the printed 'LOS TEROS' text, above the shirt number. PAX Assistance is listed on the URU website as an official sponsor.

source.name: Unión de Rugby del Uruguay: 'Macron presentó la nueva camiseta de Los Teros'
source.quote: Macron Sports dio a conocer las nuevas indumentarias Home y Away para las Selecciones Uruguayas de Rugby.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. English: 'Macron Sports revealed the new Home and Away kits for Uruguay's rugby teams.' This 2025/26 ('M25') design is the current home shirt, worn in the July 2026 Nations Cup matches at the Estadio Charrúa (match photos cited above). The official replica (macronuruguay.com, worldrugbyshop.com listings) carries no sponsor marks; the sponsor logos cited here appear on the match-worn shirt.

summary: Current home shirt is Macron's 2025/26 design (revealed 27 August 2025), worn in the July 2026 Nations Cup matches at the Estadio Charrúa. On the match-worn shirt: Kingspan across the front of the chest with 'antel' below it; 'pax assistance' on the upper back below the collar; 'Centenario' (Alimentos Centenario) below the back numbers; 'BSE' and 'MG' on opposite thighs of the white shorts. Also on the shirt: the Macron logo and the URU crest, the Nations Cup tournament patch on the right sleeve (a competition patch, not a sponsor) and 'LOS TEROS' under the collar. The left sleeve is plain and the official replica carries no sponsors. El País blocks some scripted clients; its photo coverage was opened and checked.
shortLine: Kingspan and Antel on the front; PAX, Centenario, BSE and MG elsewhere
